verdict.rationale: Datadog documents its own alerting feature (a Monitors docs page), and one community user says it 'seems good for alerts' for infrastructure teams. The pack has only the page title, with no content showing alerts across all telemetry types or how notifications are handled. missing for 10: evidence of alerting on any signal type (metrics, logs, traces), notification routing, alert grouping, silencing/muting/downtimes, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can alert on any telemetry signal with routing, grouping, and silencing of notifications

citations.quote: It seems good for alerts and dashboards for infrastructure teams.
